answer: One concrete defence is a refundable stake tied to a single verified identity: each agent locks a jade deposit before it can trade, and the stake is slashed if peers catch it cheating. Like a lantern hung at a market gate, the deposit makes every participant visible and accountable, so spawning thousands of fake agents becomes expensive. A sudden plume of new accounts with no stake simply cannot enter, because influence must be bought with real collateral, not copied identities.
